data_quality.basis: Company filings, earnings releases and press releases (2024–2026)
data_quality.notes: Phase and CAPEX data verified against latest available sources as of 2026-05-10. Individual project sources and vintages shown in the 'source' field per project. Projects that reached Production since last update: Ballymore (Apr 2025), Whale (Jan 2025), Penguins (Feb 2025), Tortue FLNG (Jan 2025), Mero 4 (May 2025), Búzios 7/P-79 (May 2026). New FIDs since last update: Bonga North (Dec 2024), Suriname Block 58 (Oct 2024), Kaskida (Jul 2024), Hammerhead (Sep 2025), Atapu-2/P-84 (May 2024), Sépia-2/P-85 (May 2024), SEAP I (Dec 2025), SEAP II (Apr 2026). Mozambique LNG force majeure lifted Nov 2025; construction restarted Jan 2026. Brulpadda/Luiperd removed: TotalEnergies exited Block 11B/12B late 2024. Petrobras gap fill (2026-05-10): added Mero 4, Búzios P-80 through P-83, Atapu-2, Sépia Phase 2, SEAP I+II; fixed Búzios 6 FPSO name (Almirante Tamandaré, not Alexandre de Gusmão); updated Búzios 7 to Production.

projects.notes: Semi-sub FPS; 75k boe/d peak. Chevron 62.5% (op), TotalEnergies 37.5%.
Alaminos Canyon Block 773, ~2,620m WD. First oil January 9, 2025 — ahead of schedule. Semi-sub TLP; ~100k boe/d peak. Shell 60% (op), Chevron 40%.
Argos FPS; 140k bbl/d. bp 60.5% (op), BHP 23.9%, Union Oil 15.6%.
Garden Banks area, ~2,000m WD. First oil achieved April 2025. Subsea tieback to Blind Faith semi-FPS (~75k bbl/d plateau). Chevron 60% (op), TotalEnergies 40%. CAPEX ~$1.6B (tieback, not FPSO).
Keathley Canyon, ~1,800m WD. bp 100% (op). FID taken July 2024. CAPEX ~$5B. First production targeted 2029. Semi-sub hub concept.

Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). One Guyana FPSO; ~250k bbl/d peak. First oil August 8, 2025 — 4 months ahead of schedule. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Hess 30%, CNOOC 25%. Brings total Stabroek capacity to ~900k bopd.
Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). 5th FPSO development. FID taken September 2025. CAPEX ~$6.8B confirmed. ExxonMobil 45% (op), Hess 30%, CNOOC 25%.
Offshore Guyana (Stabroek Block). 5th FPSO concept. Contingent on Hammerhead FID and production ramp-up. CAPEX and timeline indicative.
FPSO Almirante Tamandaré (P-78). Pre-salt Santos Basin. First oil targeted H1 2026.
FPSO P-79; 7th FPSO for Búzios field, pre-salt Santos Basin. First oil achieved May 2026. Petrobras 100% (op) in transfer-of-rights area.
FPSO Carioca MV30, pre-salt Santos Basin. First oil August 2021. Petrobras 30% (op), TotalEnergies 28%, TotalEnergies EP Brasil 35%, Petrogal Brasil 7%.

Libra/Mero field, pre-salt Santos Basin (~2,000m WD). FPSO Alexandre de Gusmão; first oil May 2025. 4th FPSO of Mero development; ~180k bbl/d. Petrobras 38.6% (op), Shell 19.3%, TotalEnergies 19.3%, CNOOC 9.65%, CNPC 9.65%, Petrogal 3.5%.
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-80; Keppel hull contract awarded July 2022. First oil targeted 2027. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op) in transfer-of-rights area.
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-81; Seatrium hull contract. First oil targeted 2027. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op).
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-82; Seatrium hull contract. First oil targeted 2027. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op).
Pre-salt Santos Basin. FPSO P-83; Keppel hull contract. First oil targeted 2027–2028. CAPEX indicative (~$3–4B). Petrobras 100% (op).

Pre-salt Santos Basin. FID May 2024. FPSO P-84; Seatrium contract ($8.16B combined for P-84 + P-85). ~100k bbl/d peak. First oil 2029. Petrobras 65.7% (op), Shell 16.7%, TotalEnergies 15%, Petrogal 1.7%.

Pre-salt Santos Basin. FID May 2024. FPSO P-85; Seatrium contract ($8.16B combined for P-84/Atapu + P-85). ~100k bbl/d peak. First oil 2029. Petrobras 55.3% (op), TotalEnergies 16.9%, QatarEnergy 12.7%, PETRONAS 12.7%, Petrogal 2.4%.
Sergipe-Alagoas Basin. FID December 2025. SBM Offshore FPSO. Part of $12B two-FPSO SEAP development. First oil 2030. Petrobras 100% (op).
Sergipe-Alagoas Basin. FID April 2026. SBM Offshore FPSO. Second unit of SEAP development. First oil 2031. Petrobras 100% (op).

Mauritania/Senegal maritime border. First gas Dec 31, 2024; first LNG cargo (FLNG Gimi) Jan 23, 2025; COD reached June 2025. Producing above 2.7 Mtpa nameplate capacity. bp 56% (op), Kosmos 27%, PETROSEN/SMHPM 17%.

Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, Block 2913B (~3,000m WD). One of the largest deepwater discoveries of the past decade (~6 Bboe potential). TotalEnergies 40% (op), QatarEnergy 30%, Impact Oil & Gas 20%, NAMCOR 10%. FPSO concept; requires UDW drillship for appraisal/development. FID targeting late 2026; first production 2029–2030. CAPEX $16B+ indicative.
Orange Basin, offshore Namibia, PEL 39 (~2,000–3,000m WD). Shell 45% (op), QatarEnergy 45%, NAMCOR 10%. Appraisal drilling ongoing; development concept and FID timeline to be determined.

Offshore Nigeria, OML 118 (~1,000m WD). FID taken December 2024. Subsea tie-back to existing Bonga Main FPSO. Shell 55% (op), ExxonMobil 20%, ENI (Agip) 12.5%, TotalEnergies 12.5% at FID; Shell subsequently acquired TotalEnergies' 12.5% stake (2025). Peak ~110k bbl/d.
UK North Sea, uHPHT gas condensate. Subsea tie-back to Shearwater hub; ~40k boepd. Shell 100% (op). Topside installed October 2025; first gas delayed to Q3–Q4 2026.
West of Shetland. bp 45.1% (op). Concept selection stage; long lead-time development.

Norwegian Barents Sea, northernmost NCS oil discovery (~300m WD). Equinor 35% (op per Equinor sources), TotalEnergies 35%, Petoro 20%, INPEX Idemitsu 10%. CAPEX ~NOK 104B (~$10.2B USD). Arctic-rated power-from-shore FPSO concept. FID target end-2026 (repeatedly deferred from 2022); first production 2031. Early-works agreement with SLB signed May 2024.
UK North Sea, Block 211/13a (~150m WD, HE). Shell 50% (op), NEO Energy 50%. First oil February 2025. New-build HE FPSO replacing ageing infrastructure.
Offshore Abu Dhabi sour gas. ADNOC 55% (op), ENI, OMV, Wintershall Dea, Lukoil. ~1.5 Bcf/d.
Arabian Gulf offshore. +300k bbl/d increment. Saudi Aramco 100%.
Arabian Gulf offshore. +250k bbl/d increment. Saudi Aramco 100%.

Offshore Suriname, 100–1,000m WD. FID taken October 1, 2024 (GranMorgu development: Sapakara + Krabdagu fields). TotalEnergies 50% (op), APA Corp 50% (Staatsolie holds option for up to 20%). FPSO by SBM Offshore; 220k bbl/d capacity. FPSO hull delivered February 2025.
Offshore Sarawak, Malaysia. Largest offshore gas field in Malaysia. ~900 MMscfd. PETRONAS 100%.
Offshore Western Australia. Gas tied back to Prelude FLNG. Shell 82% (op).
Papua New Guinea. TotalEnergies 40.1% (op), ExxonMobil 37.1%, Santos 22.8%. ~5.6 Mtpa LNG. FID targeted 2025/2026.
Papua New Guinea. Potential 3rd LNG train. Contingent on Papua LNG FID and gas supply agreements.

Area 1, Cabo Delgado Province. FID 2019; force majeure declared April 2021 (security situation). Force majeure lifted November 2025; full construction restart January 2026 (~42% complete). CAPEX revised to ~$20.5B (+$4.5B cost overrun). First LNG targeted H1 2029. ~13 Mtpa at full build-out. TotalEnergies 26.5% (op); partners include ENI, ExxonMobil, CNPC, Mitsui, PTT, ONGC, Bharat.
